activity.notes: Representative year for the 1810 family partnership that formally joined Mayer Amschel Rothschild and his five sons. The entry credits Mayer with establishing and planning the family banking network, not with the later achievements of his sons and descendants.

sources.title: Mayer Amschel Rothschild and his five sons — The Rothschild Archive
sources.citation_text: The Rothschild Archive describes Mayer Amschel's banking business and the 1810 partnership uniting him with his five sons, the basis of the later family firm.
